description: Synthetic sample listening profiles used as the OPTIONAL user-history retrieval source. These are fictional and contain no real private user data. Each profile summarises made-up 'past listening' so the retriever can surface [history:<name>] evidence when a profile is selected.

night_owl_coder.summary: Late-night listener who codes with calm, low-energy lofi and ambient instrumental tracks. Prefers acoustic, focus-friendly, no-lyric music and avoids explicit content.
night_owl_coder.notes: Studies and codes between 10pm and 2am, likes quiet focus playlists.

gym_enthusiast.summary: High-energy listener who works out to fast, upbeat, danceable pop and edm. Prefers loud driving beats with high tempo and does not mind clean high-energy tracks.
gym_enthusiast.notes: Trains most mornings and wants motivating cardio music.

weekend_relaxer.summary: Unwinds on weekends with mellow acoustic, jazz, and folk. Enjoys soothing relaxed music for quiet evenings and reflective listening.
weekend_relaxer.notes: Prefers cozy background music while reading or cooking.
